name: delegate-to-local-agent
description: Delegate a well-scoped implementation task to a local coding-agent harness (Pi, oh-my-pi, OpenCode, ...) on a local LLM in an isolated git worktree, then review, verify and integrate its diff.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate coding tasks to a local agent and review its diff.
interface.longDescription: Run implementation tasks on a local coding-agent harness (Pi, oh-my-pi, OpenCode, ...) in an isolated git worktree: write a concrete task spec, run the agent, review and verify its diff, then integrate. The orchestrator stays in control; the agent's output is treated as untrusted.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this task to the local agent.
Have the local coding agent implement this function.
Offload this refactor to my local LLM and review the result.
